# Support

## How to get help

- **Questions about usage** — open an issue in the relevant repository with
  the `question` label
- **Bug reports** — use the bug report template
- **Feature requests** — use the feature request template

Please search existing issues before opening a new one.

## What is not supported here

- Private support via email or chat
- Guarantees of response time (this is a community-driven project)
